electronics_review_analysis_correct:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT p.ref_id
    FROM products p
    JOIN reviews r ON p.category = r.category AND p.ref_id = r.ref_id
    WHERE p.category = 'electronics' AND p.price > 50
    GROUP BY p.ref_id
    HAVING COUNT(r.rating) >= 5
    AND AVG(r.rating) < 3.0
)
